sources.snippet: This page describes the Qwen3-VL-Embedding model architecture, its design principles, and how it generates semantic embeddings for multimodal inputs. The embedding model is designed for the initial recall stage in a two-stage retrieval pipeline, enabling efficient similarity search across text, images, videos, and mixed-modal content.
